problems.problem: Bottle contact with surface remains unresolved. The product_base_y (1265) is 87.8% of canvas height (1440), but the shadow.offset_y (2) is still detached from the bottle base, violating contact shadow physics. No visible fabric texture or fold at the bottle's base to confirm surface contact.
Bottle occupies 59% of canvas height (850/1440), slightly below the 50-65% hero standard. The left negative space remains overly large, creating imbalance with the right-aligned bottle.

Typography lacks hierarchy and luxury integration. The title 'j'adore' (size 84) and subtitle 'EAU DE PARFUM' (size 26.4) feel generic and disconnected from the bottle's gold accents. The font choice (Times) is inconsistent with Dior's elegant branding.
